caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged on a plain beige background within a bordered rectangular frame. At the top center, there is an ornate keyhole escutcheon plate, colored gold with black shading, featuring a symmetrical design of scrollwork and leaf motifs and a central keyhole. Below and slightly to the left is a matching handle or knob with a similar decorative motif and gold coloration, viewed from the front. To the right of this handle, there is a side-view of the same handle, revealing an elongated stem and a narrow attachment with a hole near the top. All objects feature intricate engraved patterns and are rendered with a slight three-dimensional look through shading. A linear scale or ruler is drawn at the bottom left of the frame, and there is a signature "Al. Abruzzetti" in cursive at the bottom right.
title: Drawer Pull
